commission: Perform a screenless, rollback-safe signer migration of the existing Home Center operator overlay, preserving the foreground application and local control-off state. After migration, recover background Phone Hands and run read-only Shizuku and exact Spotify-session probes. Do not click or foreground the phone, authorize Spotify, create a playlist, or start playback in this checkpoint.

preflight: Reconnect the existing paired ADB target and require the exact device serial and authorized device state.

Re-read foreground component, installed package/version/signer/APK path and hash, bounded provider state, app-ops, notification permission, Shizuku server state, and Termux state. Any unexpected material change stops before package mutation.
backupAndReadback: Force-stop only com.homecenter.operatoroverlay without launching an Activity.
Pull the installed base APK and require its local SHA-256 to equal the device sha256sum.
Generate a complete package-private tar using run-as after force-stop, plus a device-generated per-file SHA-256 manifest.
List and extract the local archive, then compare extracted file hashes to the device manifest before uninstall.
Preserve bounded provider state, app-ops, granted permissions, installed identity, foreground baseline, and all recovery hashes in one immutable migration receipt.
packageMutation: Push the exact final APK to /data/local/tmp and require remote SHA-256 5d01f34d41b875eea3de3f93135a63a0be52c4ab3ab24b4bf8c85d90f523ea5b.
Uninstall the old signer package only after both old APK and private-state recovery artifacts verify.
Install the exact durable-signed package without launching any Activity.
Require version 1.3.0/code 4, installed APK hash readback, and certificate c0652840ce34ab4e957ac6c99698c21b694c4ca09c412c473b72c02005909400.
boundedStateRestore: Restore only muted, heartbeat/update timestamps, latest_source, panel_collapsed, and overlay_hidden through the DUMP-protected restore_migration_state provider method.
Explicitly supply control_enabled=false and both screen leases as zero; the provider must reject any wider field.
Restore SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW and POST_NOTIFICATIONS when they were previously applicable.
Start only com.homecenter.operatoroverlay/.OperatorOverlayService as a foreground service.
verification: Foreground component remains exactly equal to the preflight baseline.
Provider readback shows control_enabled=0 and both screen leases 0, with bounded state matching the preserved values.
No Activity launch, screen input, deep link, generic media key, Spotify OAuth, playlist mutation, or playback occurs.
Old APK, private-state archive, file-hash manifest, and app-op/permission records remain independently readable for rollback.
rollback: On any post-uninstall failure, remove the new package if present, reinstall the preserved old APK, stream the preserved private-state tar through run-as, restore old app-ops and permissions, and start only the old OperatorOverlayService.
Require old version, signer, state, foreground component, and recovery hashes to read back before reporting rollback success.
postMigrationReadOnly: Recover Phone Hands through the background shell lane.
Attempt existing screenless Android authority to grant or verify Shizuku API permission; never open a permission prompt or click.
Probe Shizuku binder/version/permission, exact Spotify-session visibility, and typed RADIO status only. An absent or ambiguous session fails closed.

excluded: phone taps, coordinates, typing, or other screen input
Activity launch, foreground change, deep links, or browser playback
generic media keys, media-button broadcasts, or cmd media_session dispatch
Spotify OAuth, account consent, playlist creation or mutation
playback, skipping, rolling refill, App Remote, or substitute player
stopConditions: ADB serial or foreground baseline mismatch
old APK or complete private-state recovery artifacts fail independent hash/readback verification
final APK source, hash, version, or signer mismatch
foreground changes, an Activity launches, control becomes enabled, or a screen lease becomes nonzero
bounded state, app-op, notification, service-start, or rollback verification fails
Shizuku permission remains a genuine user-owned consent boundary after all existing screenless authority is exhausted
